title: Apply the current server-authorized Shared Saved View in native Case Queue HTTP
goal: Bind a server-resolved, versioned, permission-rechecked Shared Saved View to the existing native owner-authorized Case Queue GET -> Workspace handoff -> POST return workflow without inventing view storage or a second projector.
invariants: Only the authenticated host's Shared Capabilities provider supplies the selected view and per-element permission decisions; client URL/body and Case candidates may never grant or choose a view.
One existing native ProjectWithSavedViewFallback and RestoreCaseQueue implementation applies and revalidates the sanitized view on GET open and POST return.
Tenant/environment and Case/Incident/Finding object-read are checked on every request; denied saved-view fields/filters/sort never appear in output.
No Shared persistence or mutation, IAM implementation, Case assignment/export, host TLS/CSRF decisions or new third-party runtime dependencies.
security_properties: Host supplies a trusted Shared Saved View snapshot with authoritative per-element AccessDecision resolved under the current authenticated tenant/environment.
Cross-tenant or invalid saved view is rejected with generic error; a denied view falls back only to unconfigured default on fresh GET.
POST return resolves the current view again and rejects a saved-view version/revocation mismatch without treating an old token as authority.
Client-supplied view_id/tenant/saved_view JSON is not admitted by the native HTTP boundary.

migration.rationale: Read-only adapter; Shared Saved View is not persisted or mutated.

rollback.strategy: Drop optional Shared constructor and adapter; keep original default Queue GET/open/return and immutable Saved View runtime.
verification: Original default Queue HTTP tests continue
No Case or Shared Saved View mutation

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-101 full §8/12/17/25 and Shared Saved Views (cmdr-product-spec/12-shared-capabilities/saved-views.md) require permission-safe read-only application without taking Shared ownership.
Frozen Git parent PR #142 SHA a41bbcf6b2ac40f366b17c29f9bd1c573d7ce6ff, E10-INV-101K-RETURN IMPLEMENTED with exact engineering CI SUCCESS, L2 already scheduled/executed but report inaccessible.
Existing E10-INV-101C-VIEW VERIFIED provides ApplySavedView/ProjectWithSavedViewFallback and E10-INV-101D-HANDOFF VERIFIED provides RestoreCaseQueue; host native HTTP from H/J/K already exists.
outputs: Opt-in first-party native HTTP handler accepts a host Shared view resolver, not any client-selected view ID.
GET Case Queue projects only approved Shared fields/filters/sort; GET open Case and POST return each reload and reauthorize the selected view and reject changes.
Legacy Queue host constructor without Shared provider remains compatible, and denied view current GET uses existing default fallback.
acceptance_tests: Trusted Shared view with allowed status filter and denied field/filter yields only allowed Case and fields over native GET; no denied field name, filter value, Case metadata or count leaks.
GET open_case -> POST return preserves view ID/version and selection/scroll, with fresh Shared authorization on every request.
Revoked view or updated view version between open and return fails closed with no Case ID or token returned; denied view fresh GET falls back safely.
Foreign/invalid/erroring Shared provider responses fail closed, client view_id rejected before providers, legacy constructor continues default view.
Exact HEAD mandatory engineering-kernel CHK-SECURITY-TESTS and required checks succeed; independent one-shot read-only L2, native reviewer approval and Git merge remain separate.

performance_budget.rationale: One extra bounded trusted Shared read per HTTP request, reuse existing projection pass over <=5000 authorized candidates, no network/storage call owned by Case Queue
metrics: One Shared view resolved per GET/open/POST return
No duplicate Saved View filter/sort implementation
No increase in <=4MiB JSON output and candidate 5000 limit
